title: First Detection of c-C<SUB>3</SUB>H<SUB>2</SUB> in a Circumstellar Disk
question: Is c-C3H2 present in the HD 163296 disk, and what are its radial distribution, column density and ortho/para ratio?

what.value: Disk physical structure model (temperature, density, geometry; Table 3)

evidence.quote: based on a previously developed accretion disk model with well-defined temperature and density structures (cite: Qi11)
The collisional rates are taken from (cite: Chandra00)
the molecular data file is retrieved from the Leiden Atomic and Molecular Database (cite: Schoier05)

recipe.method: Calibrated SV data; continuum from line-free channels; lines continuum-subtracted and binned to 1 km/s; taper for weak lines
Per-channel masks from 6-5 emission applied to all c-C3H2 lines

recipe.goal: Fit radial ring model in the uv-plane
recipe.method: Grid of synthetic 6-5 visibilities over Rout, Rin, p, N100; chi2 minimization on real and imaginary visibilities
assumptions: Keplerian rotation; Qi11 disk structure; constant abundance in a layer; power-law column density

recipe.method: Fit unresolved 5-4 ortho line flux assuming 6-5 distribution; compare with total from 6-5
assumptions: 6-5 ortho and para lines blended with equal A coefficients; fit ortho only gives o+p

evidence.quote: the flux is determined to be 608.5$\pm$2.5 mJy

answer_key.quantity: Best-fit inner radius, outer radius, power-law index
answer_key.uncertainty: 1 sigma: Rin 15-40, Rout 150-200 AU, p -2.5 to -1.5

evidence.quote: with best-fit values at -2, 30 and 165 AU, respectively (reduced $\chi^2=1.07$)
N($c$-C$_3$H$_2$) is determined to be 2.2$\pm$0.2 $\times$10$^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$ at 100 AU
Hence $o/p$=2.7$\pm$1.7, which is close to the statistical value of 3

not_stated_but_needed: Imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, clean threshold)
Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Details of the chi2 model grid ranges and step sizes
missing_for_reproduction: Model grid specification and RATRAN settings
Qi11 disk model parameter table is external
score_reason: Public data and scripts, clear model approach, but fitting grid and masking details are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Public SV data and a stated ring-model recipe with numeric results, though requires the Qi11 model.
